name: scan-instruction-files
description: Asks a person before a change adds injection text to an agent instruction file (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md, Cursor/Windsurf/Cline/Roo/Kiro rules, Copilot instructions and prompts, SKILL.md, agent commands): rule overrides, secrecy, auto-approve, hook or review bypass, fetch-and-run, remote instructions, role swaps, fake system tags, removed guardrails. Refuses secret exfiltration and encoded payloads. Added text only; English phrases; friction, not a boundary. [Session-enforced via PreToolUse and Stop hooks; needs git and a Python 3.11+. PreToolUse judges the file a tool call would write; Stop re-reads what the turn actually left on disk, so a file written through a shell heredoc is judged too. With no working Python the hook exits 2; without git, fail-open clients allow silently. A gate that cannot reach a decision refuses rather than allowing one it never judged. Enforcement at every commit and in CI still needs chock installed in the repo.]
